Does the Kenya Airways Upgrade to Business Class apply to the round trip? Can I choose any amount I want for my Upgrade offer?

The system has a default minimum and maximum bid amount set. It will not accept any offer lower than the minimum amount or higher than the maximum amount. All flight legs of your booking which are suitable for an Upgrade will be displayed. You decide for yourself which flights you'd like to make an offer on.

What does the Strength Indicator mean on the offer page?

The Strength Indicator is a guide that shows the strength of your bid but does not guarantee its success.

Can I offer different amounts for the Upgrade for each segment of my journey?

Yes, you can offer different amounts for each eligible segment.

How much does it cost to make an offer?

The offer is free of charge. Only if you receive the Upgrade, your credit card will be debited with the amount of your offer. Please, we still need your credit card details at the time of making your offer for standard verification purposes.

Can I change my Offer to a higher or lower amount?

Yes, you can change the amount before you receive a confirmation email informing you whether your Offer has been successful or not. All you need to do to change your Offer is to use the link from the upgrade offer email.

Apart from the Upgrade amount displayed, will there be additional taxes or charges?

No.

If you wish to file a claim or an action regarding delay of Checked Baggage, you must notify us within twenty-one (21) Days from the date the Baggage has been placed at your disposal. Every such notification must be made in writing.

10.1.3 Refunds will only be made Subject to the ticket rules.

10.2 INVOLUNTARY REFUNDS

10.2.1 If we cancel a flight, fail to operate a flight reasonably according to schedule, fail to stop at your destination or Stopover, or cause you to miss a connecting flight on which you hold a reservation, the amount of the refund shall be:

10.2.1.1 if no portion of the Ticket has been used, an amount equal to the fare paid;

10.2.1.2 if a portion of the Ticket has been used, not less than the difference between the fare paid and the applicable fare for travel between the points for which the Ticket has been used.

10.3 VOLUNTARY REFUNDS

10.3.1 If you are entitled to a refund of your Ticket for reasons other than those set out in Article 10.2, the amount of the refund shall be:

10.3.1.1 if no portion of the Ticket has been used, an amount equal to the fare paid, less any reasonable service charges or cancellation fees;

10.3.1.2 if a portion of the Ticket has been used, the refund will be an amount equal to the difference between the fare paid and the applicable fare for travel between the points for which the Ticket has been used, less any reasonable service charges or cancellation fees.

10.4 RIGHT TO REFUSE REFUND

10.4.1 We may refuse a refund where application is made after the expiry of the validity of the Ticket.

9.3 DENIED BOARDING COMPENSATION

If we are unable to provide previously confirmed space, we shall provide compensation to those Passengers denied boarding in accordance with applicable law and our denied boarding compensation policy. A copy of our denied boarding compensation policy is available upon request. Eligibility for denied boarding compensation is conditional on passengers having complied with check-in and boarding deadlines. Compensation may include monetary reimbursement, alternate transportation on another carrier, or downgrade refund, in accordance with applicable law and our denied boarding compensation policy.

ARTICLE 10: REFUNDS

10.1 We will refund a Ticket or any unused portion, in accordance with the applicable fare rules or Tariff, as follows:

10.1.1 Except as otherwise provided in this Article, we shall be entitled to make a refund either to the person named in the Ticket or to the person who has paid for the Ticket, upon presentation of satisfactory proof of such payment.

10.1.2 If a Ticket has been paid for by a person other than the Passenger named in the Ticket, and the Ticket indicates that there is a restriction on refund, we shall make a refund only to the person who paid for the Ticket, or to that person's order.

10.1.3 Refunds will only be made Subject to the ticket rules.

10.2 INVOLUNTARY REFUNDS

Taxes, Fees and Charges:

[List level 1] - Applicable taxes, fees and charges imposed by government or other authority, or by the operator of an airport, shall be payable by you. At the time you purchase your Ticket, you will be advised of taxes, fees and charges not included in the fare, most of which will normally be shown separately on the Ticket.

The taxes, fees and charges imposed on air travel are constantly changing and can be imposed after the date of Ticket issuance. If there is an increase in a tax, fee or charge shown on the Ticket, you will be obliged to pay it. Likewise, if a new tax, fee or charge is imposed even after Ticket issuance, you will be obliged to pay it. Similarly, in the event any taxes, fees or charges which you have paid to us at the time of Ticket issuance are abolished or reduced such that they no longer apply to you, or a lesser amount is due, you will be entitled to claim a refund.

In addition should the Passenger not travel on a flight and they are holding a refundable or a non refundable ticket they are equally to benefit from a refund of said applicable taxes, charges and other fees.

[List level 1] - For tickets bought on kenya-airways.com (Link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/ ) you may be eligible to apply for a refund using the refund widget. If your inbound travel is in the future and your booking is still active.

ARTICLE 11: CONDUCT ABOARD AIRCRAFT

11.1 GENERAL

If, in our reasonable opinion, you conduct yourself aboard the aircraft so as to endanger the aircraft or any person or property on board, or obstruct the crew in the performance of their duties, or fail to comply with any instructions of the crew, including but not limited to those with respect to smoking, alcohol or drug consumption, or behave in a manner which causes discomfort, inconvenience, damage or injury to other passengers or the crew, including but not limited to harassment, threats, or hoax threats, we may take such measures as we deem reasonably necessary to prevent continuation of such conduct, including restraint. You may be disembarked and refused onward carriage at any point, and may be prosecuted for offences committed on board the aircraft.

Self Rebooking (FAQs)

What is the KQ Self Rebooking Service?

It is a self-service option by Kenya Airways that allows you to rebook your flight easily in case your flight is canceled or rescheduled.

Will I be charged to use the self-rebooking service?

No, The service is absolutely free.

Will my flight preferences and services remain the same?

Yes, all your service selections remain the same. I.e. same destination, same travel class, same baggage allowances.

What do I need to rebook myself?

You only need your booking reference or e-ticket number.

Where do I go to rebook my flight?

Simply visit the Kenya Airways website(Link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/ ), select “Manage Booking”

You will find the rebooking link at the top marked “Click here.

Where do I find the flight options available for rebooking?

Once you log in, you will be redirected to a page that has all available flight options and timings.

Where do I find the flight options available for rebooking?

Once you log in, you will be redirected to a page that has all available flight options and timings.

*Flight timings available for rebooking are either less than 24 hours from your original flight or 7 days after.

Can I rebook a flight that hasn’t been disrupted?

No. Only flights with a schedule change i.e. delayed or canceled are open for self-rebooking.

What happens if I do not rebook myself/are not able to rebook?

The system will automatically rebook you on the next available flight, after which you will receive an email with your new flight details.

Will I receive my e-ticket and boarding pass?

Yes, after you have selected and confirmed your new flight, you will receive an email confirmation as well as your e-ticket.

I have received an email that my flight has been canceled/rescheduled. Does that mean I have been rebooked?

The system will automatically rebook you on the next available flight. If you are happy with the new flight details highlighted on the email, click on “ACCEPT CHANGES”

However, if you would like to see more flight options, go to the Kenya Airways website and click on Manage my booking where you will have the option to rebook yourself on your preferred flight. DO NOT CLICK ON DECLINE CHANGES as this will automatically direct you to the Customer Excellence Centre to rebook you.

Will I be charged for rebooking and how can I be refunded?

Self rebooking tool is purposely for disrupted flights. You will therefore not be charged for using it.

Escape the hassle of queues and maximize your time at the airport. Experience the convenience of online flight check-in – available from anywhere, at any time.

For international flights, the online check-in window opens 48 hours before your scheduled departure (24 hours before for flights involving the United States) and remains accessible until just 1 hour before takeoff. Domestic flight passengers are encouraged to complete their check-in at least one and a half hours prior to departure, with the counters closing 30 minutes before the flight leaves.

But that's not all – take control of your travel experience by selecting your preferred seats before you even step on the plane. Make your journey truly yours by securing your favorite spots in the cabin.

By optig for online check-in, you're not just saving time; you're ensuring a smooth and stress-free start to your journey. Say goodbye to long lines and hello to an effortless way to prepare for your flight

When can I Check in?

Online Check-in:

With an electronic ticket, online check-in can be performed from 48 hours up until 1 hour before departure. By taking advantage of this service, you can bypass long lines at selected airports and even pick your preferred seat. Once completed, you can print your boarding pass at your convenience. When you arrive at the airport, use the designated online check-in drop-off point for your luggage and then proceed to the boarding gate. Kenya Airways has taken online check-in to new heights, providing a smoother and more convenient experience.

safety requirements, we strongly recommend you to book early as seats are available on a first-come, first-served basis.

What should I do if my Promotional Code is not working?

Use the feedback icon hanging on the right side of your browsing window

Where do I present my credit/debit card?

If Kenya Airways advise you to present the card used for booking, it must be presented while checking into your flight at the commencement of travel. If you, as the credit card holder, are not travelling, a copy of the credit card with an authorization signed by yourself should be presented at check-in.

Alternatively, the card or a copy of the card with your signed authorization can be presented to the nearest Kenya Airways ticketing office at least 72 hours before the flight. This verification is required to ensure a smooth check-in process at the airport and to avoid being denied access to board. Failure to comply will result in the requirement to pay the full ticket cost at the airport.

What should I do if something went wrong with my payment?

Please talk to us through our Customer Service Support Section on the website where you will get real time feedback or you can contact our Global Contact Center.

What currency should I use to pay at Kenya-airways.com?

Bookings made at Kenya-airways.com should be paid for in the currency in which the ticket price is calculated locally. If you make a booking at Kenya-airways.com, the price for your ticket will be shown throughout the booking procedure in the currency you will ultimately use to pay for the ticket. It is not possible to pay in any other currency than what is indicated at Kenya-airways.com

Does the Kenya Airways Upgrade to Business Class apply to the round trip? Can I choose any amount I want for my Upgrade offer?

The system has a default minimum and maximum bid amount set. It will not accept any offer lower than the minimum amount or higher than the maximum amount. What does the Strength Indicator mean on the offer page?

The Strength Indicator is a guide that shows the strength of your bid but does not guarantee its success.

Can I offer different amounts for the Upgrade for each segment of my journey?

Yes, you can offer different amounts for each eligible segment.

How much does it cost to make an offer?

The offer is free of charge. Only if you receive the Upgrade, your credit card will be debited with the amount of your offer. Please, we still need your credit card details at the time of making your offer for standard verification purposes.

Can I change my Offer to a higher or lower amount?

Yes, you can change the amount before you receive a confirmation email informing you whether your Offer has been successful or not. All you need to do to change your Offer is to use the link from the upgrade offer email.

Apart from the Upgrade amount displayed, will there be additional taxes or charges?

No.

Will I be charged for rebooking and how can I be refunded?

Self rebooking tool is purposely for disrupted flights. You will therefore not be charged for using it.

If my outbound flight has been changed, can I also change the inbound flight free of charge?

No. With the self-rebooking tool, you will only re-book yourself on the alternative flights of the disrupted sectors. If you wish to change the inbound because you lost a day(s) on the outbound, you will have to reach out to your travel agent or our Contact center office.

If checked-in, will the bags be transferred automatically to the new flight?

Yes, they will be transferred automatically.

Does the tool rebook other airlines document with KQ sectors like DL or AF?

Yes, it does. However, instead of revalidation, the ticket will be reissued.

Does the tool rebook award tickets?

Yes, it does

What happens if a flight is disrupted more than once?

You can self-rebook once per every disruption.

Baggage Restrictions

Link to Baggage Restrictions website page: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/plan/baggage-information/baggage-restrictions/

Please ensure that you do not pack items specified in this list in your carry-on or checked baggage.

Medically necessary needles and syringes are exempt from these prohibitions if passengers have in their possession prescription medication with a professionally printed label that identifies the medical office, pharmacy, or manufacturer of the medication.

Prohibited Items

For the safety of our passengers and aircraft, passengers are prohibited from carrying the following items in either checked or hand baggage:

[List level 1] - Explosives, munitions, fireworks, and flares

[List level 1] - Security-type cases/boxes incorporating goods such as lithium batteries or pyrotechnics

[List level 1] - Compressed gases (flammable, non-flammable, or poisonous) such as butane, propane, aqualung cylinders, lighter fuels, or refills

[List level 1] - Oxidizing substances such as bleaching powder and peroxides

[List level 1] - Flammable liquids such as paints and adhesives

[List level 1] - Disabling devices such as mace or pepper sprays, with irritant properties

[List level 1] - Poisons such as arsenic, cyanides, or insecticides

[List level 1] - Radioactive materials

[List level 1] - Corrosive materials such as mercury (which may be contained in thermometers or blood pressure gauges,) acids, alkalis, and wet cell batteries

[List level 1] - Any other substances which, during a flight, present a danger not covered above, such as magnetized, offensive, or irritating materials

[List level 1] - To help us process your claim quickly, please quote the reference given to you when you reported your baggage as delayed or damaged.

More Information

First Needs Allowance (FNA) Payment:

Payment may be made to passengers who arrive at destinations other than their domicile country of residence without their checked baggage. It shall be noted that not all such passengers may need payment.

NOTE: Persons who are residents do not qualify for first needs payment, unless they show proof of residence in another country other than their domicile country for the last 6 months.

The following provisions shall therefore apply for delayed bags not received within 24hrs at the arrival airport where the missing report was filed: after 24 hours:

[List level 1] - First Needs Allowance (FNA) may be paid on the spot where it is ascertained that based on flight schedules, frequencies and connectivity, the missing bags shall not arrive within 24hours.

[List level 1] - Passengers receiving at least one of their bags may not be entitled to First Needs Allowance.

[List level 1] - Proof of Purchase of first needs items in form of receipts is required;

[List level 1] - Only essential items can be reimbursed;

[List level 1] - Applicable limits are:

[List level 1] - USD150 for First class and Premier World

[List level 1] - USD100 for Economy class passengers

[List level 1] - Children between 2-12 yrs. are entitled to 50% of the applicable limits in Economy and Business Class

[List level 1] - Children below 2 years are not entitled to First Needs Allowance Payment.

8.2 EXCESS BAGGAGE

You will be required to pay a charge for carriage of Baggage in excess of the free Baggage allowance. These rates are available from us upon request.

8.3 ITEMS UNACCEPTABLE AS BAGGAGE

8.3.1 You must not include in your Baggage:

8.3.1.1 items which are likely to endanger the aircraft or persons or property on board the aircraft, such as those specified in the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) Technical Instructions for the Safe Transport of Dangerous Goods by Air and the International Air Transport Association (IATA) Dangerous Goods Regulations, and in our regulations (further information is available from us on request);

8.3.1.2 items the carriage of which is prohibited by the applicable laws, regulations or orders of any state to be flown from or to;

8.3.1.3 items which are reasonably considered by us to be unsuitable for carriage because they are dangerous or unsafe, or because of their weight, size, shape or character, or because they are fragile or perishable having regard to, among other things, the type of aircraft being used. Information about unacceptable items is available upon request.

8.3.2 Firearms and ammunition other than for hunting and sporting purposes are prohibited from carriage as Baggage. Firearms and ammunition for hunting and sporting purposes may be accepted as Checked Baggage. Firearms must be unloaded, with the safety catch on, and suitably packed. Carriage of ammunition is subject to ICAO and IATA regulations as specified in Article 8.3.1.1.

Should you not collect it within a reasonable time, we may charge you a storage fee. Should your Checked Baggage not be claimed within three (3) months of the time it is made available, we may dispose of it without any liability to you.

8.8.2 Only the bearer of the Baggage Check and Baggage Identification Tag is entitled to delivery of the Checked Baggage.

8.8.3 If a person claiming Checked Baggage is unable to produce the Baggage Check and identify the Baggage by means of a Baggage Identification Tag, we will deliver the Baggage to such person only on condition that he or she establishes to our satisfaction his or her right to the Baggage.

8.9 Animals

We reserve the right, at our absolute discretion, to refuse to carry any animals. If we agree to carry any animals they will be carried subject to the following conditions:

8.9.1 You must ensure that animals such as dogs, cats, household birds and other pets, are properly crated (or carried in a container complying with any applicable legal requirements) and accompanied by valid health and vaccination certificates, entry permits, and other documents required by countries of entry or transit, failing which they will not be accepted for carriage. Such carriage may be subject to additional conditions specified by us, which are available on request.

8.9.2 If accepted as Baggage, the animal, together with its container and food, shall not be included in your free Baggage allowance, but shall constitute excess baggage, for which you will be obliged to pay the applicable rate.

8.9.3 Guide dogs accompanying Passengers with disabilities will be carried free of charge in addition to the normal free baggage allowance, subject to conditions specified by us, which are available on request.

NOTE; (relevant fees applicable), and Medical services available at a fee

10. Animals on Board

Kenya Airways offers this service free of charge for passengers who require assistance through trained and certified dogs.

Service dog – a dog, regardless of breed or type, that is individually trained to do work or perform tasks for the benefit of a qualified individual with a disability, including a physical, sensory, psychiatric, intellectual, or other mental disability, and any other condition required to have (service dog)SVAN.

Animal species other than dogs, emotional support animals, comfort animals, companionship animals, and service animals in training are not service animals.

General Conditions for Acceptance:

Advance booking reservation is required up to 48hrs to departure. Contact KQ Medical team: Doctors.KQ@kenya-airways.com or Contact Centre

Tel: +254 734 104 747, Mobile: +254 711 024 747 or Whatsapp +254 705 474 747. For flights to and from the U.S., you must provide us with a completed U.S. Department of Transportation Service Animal Air Transportation Form and U.S. Department of Transportation Service Animal Relief Attestation Form.

[List level 1] - If you are a passenger traveling from John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK), United States, please get in touch with the Ark. They can help you with all the necessary paperwork, handle your pet, and ensure that it is healthy enough to travel.

[List level 1] - Duly filled dog import form verified by the Centers for Disease Control(CDC), KQ SVAN form , and MEDIF form to Doctors.KQ@kenya-airways.com.

[List level 1] - Only accepted on all KQ Direct (Non-stop) flights. No transfers for service animals will be provided.

[List level 1] - Maximum of one (1) dog per passenger.

Pet Carriage

Pet Carriage website link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/plan/baggage-information/pet-carriage/

Live animals will not be accepted as checked-in Animal in Hold (AVIH) or Pet in Cabin (PETC) on Kenya Airways flights.

Live animals shall be consigned as cargo only.

Exception

Service Dog

Service dog shall be accepted in the cabin if it’s providing assistance to a person with disability i.e. Blind guest, a person with mental or psychiatric disorder. The dog is certified and individually trained to provide assistance to a person with a disability.

For more information on health and import documents needed to transport a service dog, contact KQ Cargo for guidance.

Note: All service dogs must be trained to be accepted. Emotional support dogs are no longer considered as service animals.

Passengers with physical, sensory, psychiatric, intellectual, or other mental disabilities who need to travel with a service dog may be required to present certain documentation from a licensed medical health professional that is treating the passenger, dated within one year, stating that the service dog is necessary for the passenger/s mental health or treatment during air travel and/or any activity at the passengers’ destination.

Service Dogs are:

[List level 1] - Accepted free of charge.

[List level 1] - They can be accepted in the cabin without a kennel/cage provided they are properly harnessed and do not occupy a seat.

[List level 1] - Service dogs are trained to behave properly. An animal that shows disruptive behavior cannot be accepted as a guide animal even if it performs assistive function for the guest.

1] - Dog Health Certificate

[List level 1] - Import/Export documentation

[List level 1] - Letter from a veterinary doctor

[List level 1] - Dog training certificate

2. Service/Emotional Support dogs MUST always wear a harness and must always remain with the passenger.

3. Valid documentation shall not be older than 1 year from departure dates.

Notes:

[List level 1] - The restrictions for travelling with animals may differ for various countries/airports. Passengers are therefore responsible for arranging necessary formalities.

[List level 1] - Passengers with service animals and emotional support animals will NOT be assigned Emergency Exit seats/rows.

[List level 1] - Service & Emotional support dogs’ onboard aircrafts MUST be trained to behave in public.

[List level 1] - Service & Emotional support dogs should not be subjected to using masks and sanitising liquids.

[List level 1] - Final verification is at the airport, where KQ Customer service representative will authorise service or emotional support dog travel on board.

DOT Contacts:

Consumers can obtain a copy of Part 382 in an accessible format from the Department of Transportation by any of the following means:

[List level 1] - For calls made from within the United States, by telephone via the Toll-Free Hotline for Air Travelers with Disabilities at 1-800-778-4838 (voice) or 1-800-455-9880 (TTY).

[List level 1] - For calls made from within the United States, by telephone via the Toll-Free Hotline for Air Travelers with Disabilities at 1-800-778-4838 (voice) or 1-800-455-9880 (TTY),

[List level 1] - For calls made from within the United States, by telephone via the Toll-Free Hotline for Air Travelers with Disabilities at 1-800-778-4838 (voice) or 1-800-455-9880 (TTY),

- Accepted free of charge.

[List level 1] - They can be accepted in the cabin without a kennel/cage provided they are properly harnessed and do not occupy a seat.

[List level 1] - Service dogs are trained to behave properly. An animal that shows disruptive behavior cannot be accepted as a guide animal even if it performs assistive function for the guest.

[List level 1] - On a flight segment which is 8 hours or more, ask the guest to provide documentation that the animal will not need to relieve itself during the flight or if the guest has in possession any items for the animal (e.g. nappies, medicine) to avoid any health or sanitation issue on the flight. If this is not the case, the guide dog cannot be accepted.

[List level 1] - Passengers with service dogs can be accepted on any seat in the cabin except exit rows.

[List level 1] - The animal shall sit at the feet of the passenger seat (or at the feet/floor of the adjacent seat , if it is not occupied)

[List level 1] - The service dog shall not obstruct the aisle.

[List level 1] - Advanced reservation is required, PNR “ESAN’

[List level 1] - The information is also made available in the PIL in order to inform the crew.

Transportation of Dogs to USA

From July 14 through October 14, 2021, dogs coming from high risk countries (link: https://www.cdc.gov/importation/dogs/high-risk-countries.html ) with CDC Dog Import Permits can enter the United States at one of these 18 airports: Anchorage, Atlanta, Boston, Chicago (ORD), Dallas (DFW), Detroit, Honolulu, Houston (IAH), Los Angeles, Miami, Minneapolis, New York (JFK), Newark, Philadelphia, San Francisco, San Juan, Seattle, and Washington, DC (Dulles).

[List level 1] - Maximum of one (1) dog per passenger.

[List level 1] - Import/Export documentation

[List level 1] - Dog training certificate

Kenya Airways offers this service free of charge for passengers who require assistance through trained and certified dogs.

Service dog – a dog, regardless of breed or type, that is individually trained to do work or perform tasks for the benefit of a qualified individual with a disability, including a physical, sensory, psychiatric, intellectual, or other mental disability, and any other condition required to have (service dog)SVAN.

Animal species other than dogs, emotional support animals, comfort animals, companionship animals, and service animals in training are not service animals.

General Conditions for Acceptance:

Advance booking reservation is required up to 48hrs to departure. Contact KQ Medical team: Doctors.KQ@kenya-airways.com or Contact Centre

Tel: +254 734 104 747, Mobile: +254 711 024 747 or Whatsapp +254 705 474 747. Equitel is a mobile payment option from Kenya. Once payment has been made, we will send your e-ticket to you by e-mail.

Vodacom Mpesa

This is Vodacom mpesa is a mobile money transfer service in Tanzania. Once payment has been made, we will send your e-ticket to you by e-mail.

MTN Mobile Money

MTN Mobile money is a secure mobile money wallet used to store funds, send and receive money. Guests can pay for their tickets though this mobile money option and once payment has been made, we will send your e-ticket to you by e-mail.

Tigo Pesa

This mobile money payment option is available in Tanzania. Tigo Pesa allows customers to send and receive money, buy airtime, pay bills, pay for goods and services from their mobile phones. Once the guest opts to make a payment via Tigo pesa, the e-ticket is sent to their email address.

Other Methods of Payment (AMOPs)

Mobile Banking or Bank Transfer

This form of payment is currently available in the Kenya, Nigeria and a few selected African countries. It is a real time 24-hour digital payment solution that allows for bank-to-bank transfers at a low cost. it is easy to use, fast, convenient, secure and affordable. This option is available for online banking, mobile apps, and USSD mobile banking.

Cash Payment

You can pay by cash after you have made your online booking. You then pay and retrieve your ticket at a Kenya Airways ticket office. Important to note: there is usually a fee charged for cash payments. If you wish to pay at the ticket office, make sure to bring along the booking confirmation or booking code that you received by e-mail. Please note: Not all ticket offices accept cash payments.

the world, most commonly through Visa-branded credit cards, debit cards and prepaid cards. On pay page choose payment options, next select the organization that issued the credit card. Enter all necessary details and confirm your booking. Once your payment has been authorized, you will be sent an e-ticket and payment confirmation by e-mail.

American Express

American Express Company (Amex) is an American multinational corporation specialized in payment card services. We accept both debit and credit cards for Amex.

On pay page choose payment options, next select the organization that issued the credit card. Enter all necessary details and confirm your booking. Once your payment has been authorized, you will be sent an e-ticket and payment confirmation by e-mail.

Mobile Money

For your convenience, we offer a range of mobile money payment options to make booking your flight easier.

These Include:

Mpesa

M-Pesa (M for mobile, pesa is Swahili for money) is a mobile phone-based money transfer service. Operating in Kenya and Tanzania. Once payment has been made, we will send your e-ticket to you by e-mail.

Airtel Money

This is a mobile money transfer service. Operating in Kenya, Tanzania and other countries. Once payment has been made, we will send your e-ticket to you by e-mail.

Equitel

Vodacom Mpesa

This is Vodacom mpesa is a mobile money transfer service in Tanzania. Once payment has been made, we will send your e-ticket to you by e-mail.

MTN Mobile Money

should be paid for in the currency in which the ticket price is calculated locally. If you make a booking at Kenya-airways.com, the price for your ticket will be shown throughout the booking procedure in the currency you will ultimately use to pay for the ticket. It is not possible to pay in any other currency than what is indicated at Kenya-airways.com

What form of payments can I use to pay for Time to Think?

You may use any form of payment acceptable on the Website or Mobile App and any of our Ticketing offices i.e Credit cards, Debit cards, M-pesa, Airtel Money, Paypal, Cash etc.

Do I have to pay for my ticket straightaway?

When you book a ticket at Kenya-airways.com, the payment conditions depend on the payment option you selected. Your ticket will be issued as soon as we have received your payment. ne. This will be done through the normal refund process from issuing office.

How can I get a proof of payment?

Your ticket states details about the fare and taxes paid for your flight. It is your proof of payment and will be widely accepted as a receipt.

After booking your flight on Kenya-airways.com you will receive your ticket via e-mail as soon as we have received the payment.

Can I pay for a ticket for another person travelling from abroad?

information

[List level 1] - Pay in advance for excess baggage

[List level 1] - Request for refund

Can I modify my flight details online if I booked it through a travel agent or another website?

Bookings purchased directly from Kenya-airways.com, Kenya Airways direct offices and preferred travel agents can be modified online through Manage My Booking.

For flights purchased from travel agents and 3rd party websites, you need to contact your travel agent in case of ticket refund.

When booking online, where can I find the fare rules of my ticket?

Our fare categories give you the flexibility that best suits your travel plans:

[List level 1] - Best Buy

[List level 1] - Economy

[List level 1] - Economy flex

[List level 1] - Economy Super flex

[List level 1] - Business Best Buy

[List level 1] - Business

What is the refund policy on a ticket with different branded fares?

If your booking involves more than one branded fare, the most restrictive fare rule will apply to your whole itinerary. Fees for booking changes are non-refundable.

How do I edit or correct my name in my ticket?

Contact our Global Contact Centers or local offices to correct a name in a booking. Rules and fees apply.

Can I change or transfer my ticket to another person?

No, you are not allowed to switch names or transfer your ticket to a friend or a family member.

Do I need to call Kenya Airways to reconfirm my flight?

If your booking is successful, there is no need to call us. You can check in online or at the airport on the day of departure.

What is an Extra Legroom Seat?

safety requirements, we strongly recommend you to book early as seats are available on a first-come, first-served basis.

Extra Legroom Seats are subject to availability, terms & conditions, and other eligibility requirements.

What should I do if my Promotional Code is not working?

Use the feedback icon hanging on the right side of your browsing window

Where do I present my credit/debit card?

If Kenya Airways advise you to present the card used for booking, it must be presented while checking into your flight at the commencement of travel. If you, as the credit card holder, are not travelling, a copy of the credit card with an authorization signed by yourself should be presented at check-in.

Alternatively, the card or a copy of the card with your signed authorization can be presented to the nearest Kenya Airways ticketing office at least 72 hours before the flight. This verification is required to ensure a smooth check-in process at the airport and to avoid being denied access to board. Failure to comply will result in the requirement to pay the full ticket cost at the airport.

What should I do if something went wrong with my payment?

Please talk to us through our Customer Service Support Section on the website where you will get real time feedback or you can contact our Global Contact Center.

What currency should I use to pay at Kenya-airways.com?

Bookings made at Kenya-airways.com should be paid for in the currency in which the ticket price is calculated locally. If you make a booking at Kenya-airways.com, the price for your ticket will be shown throughout the booking procedure in the currency you will ultimately use to pay for the ticket. It is not possible to pay in any other currency than what is indicated at Kenya-airways.com

or transfer my ticket to another person?

Do I need to call Kenya Airways to reconfirm my flight?

If your booking is successful, there is no need to call us. You can check in online or at the airport on the day of departure.

What is an Extra Legroom Seat?

The extra Legroom Seats are located in Economy Class exit rows with a generous space for you to stretch out. It is offered only on Kenya Airways-operated flights and is not available on flights operated by our partner airlines.

Extra Legroom Seats are subject to availability, terms & conditions, and other eligibility requirements. Please view all requirements before making your purchase to ensure you meet all of the criteria.

Who can book an Extra Legroom Seat?

Where do I present my credit/debit card?

If Kenya Airways advise you to present the card used for booking, it must be presented while checking into your flight at the commencement of travel. If you, as the credit card holder, are not travelling, a copy of the credit card with an authorization signed by yourself should be presented at check-in.

Alternatively, the card or a copy of the card with your signed authorization can be presented to the nearest Kenya Airways ticketing office at least 72 hours before the flight. This verification is required to ensure a smooth check-in process at the airport and to avoid being denied access to board. Failure to comply will result in the requirement to pay the full ticket cost at the airport.

What should I do if something went wrong with my payment?

What currency should I use to pay at Kenya-airways.com?

Bookings made at Kenya-airways.com should be paid for in the currency in which the ticket price is calculated locally. If you make a booking at Kenya-airways.com, the price for your ticket will be shown throughout the booking procedure in the currency you will ultimately use to pay for the ticket. It is not possible to pay in any other currency than what is indicated at Kenya-airways.com

Enter your check-in information using this link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/book-manage/post-booking/check-in/

Escape the hassle of queues and maximize your time at the airport. Experience the convenience of online flight check-in – available from anywhere, at any time.

For international flights, the online check-in window opens 48 hours before your scheduled departure (24 hours before for flights involving the United States) and remains accessible until just 1 hour before takeoff. Domestic flight passengers are encouraged to complete their check-in at least one and a half hours prior to departure, with the counters closing 30 minutes before the flight leaves.

But that's not all – take control of your travel experience by selecting your preferred seats before you even step on the plane. Make your journey truly yours by securing your favorite spots in the cabin.

By optig for online check-in, you're not just saving time; you're ensuring a smooth and stress-free start to your journey. Say goodbye to long lines and hello to an effortless way to prepare for your flight

When can I Check in?

Online Check-in:

With an electronic ticket, online check-in can be performed from 48 hours up until 1 hour before departure. By taking advantage of this service, you can bypass long lines at selected airports and even pick your preferred seat. Once completed, you can print your boarding pass at your convenience. When you arrive at the airport, use the designated online check-in drop-off point for your luggage and then proceed to the boarding gate. Kenya Airways has taken online check-in to new heights, providing a smoother and more convenient experience.

International Check-in:

preferred seat. Once completed, you can print your boarding pass at your convenience. When you arrive at the airport, use the designated online check-in drop-off point for your luggage and then proceed to the boarding gate. Kenya Airways has taken online check-in to new heights, providing a smoother and more convenient experience.

International Check-in:

For international flights, it is mandatory for all passengers to complete the check-in process a minimum of two and a half hours before the flight's departure, regardless of the travel class. The check-in counters close precisely one hour before the scheduled departure time.

Domestic Check-in:

Passengers traveling on domestic flights must present a valid form of identification during check-in. It is required to complete the check-in process at least one and a half hours prior to departure, regardless of the travel class. The check-in counters close half an hour before takeoff.

Check-in from China Guangzhou:

Passengers departing from China Guangzhou are advised to note that the check-in counters in this location will be closed an hour and a half (90 minutes) before the scheduled flight departure.

Priority Check-in:

Travelers who hold Asante Rewards Elite status (Gold and Platinum levels) and are flying from Nairobi to any destination can enjoy the privileges of priority check-in and boarding. This also includes access to the lounge with one guest. Always remember to present your Asante Rewards card at the counter to automatically register your earned miles. If you possess sufficient miles, request an upgrade to experience the services of our business class.

[List level 1] - For security reasons only families are allowed to register their checked baggage in one check-in record.

[List level 1] - For groups during check-in, each passenger in the group will check-in their baggage individually but the total allowance for the group applies.

[List level 1] - Excess charges apply if:

1. Each piece checked in exceeds the free weight allowance or piece/s allowed for all the family members, group or party.

Note: The pooling consist in pooling the number of baggage but not the weight per piece for example if Free Baggage Allowance = 2PC of 23 kg each, customers cannot come with 1 bag of 18 kg and another of 26 kg).

2. A special baggage has been checked in, for which a charge is due e.g. sporting equipment

Extra Seat for Cabin Baggage, Cargo, Mail (CBBG) or Passenger Comfort (EXST)

Extra seat(s) can be booked for passenger’s comfort (e.g. leg rest, etc.) or for stowage of cabin baggage (e.g. valuables, diplomatic pouch, fragile items, musical instruments, paintings etc.)

Baggage Allowance for an Extra seat purchased

Acceptance Conditions

[List level 1] - Extra seat(s) shall be requested and paid for in advance. Approval is needed from Revenue Management.

[List level 1] - The normal applicable free checked baggage allowance applies for every extra seat booked (EXST). For example, 1 passenger books 2 extra M-Class seats for comfort. The total checked baggage allowance for this passenger will be 3 x applicable free baggage allowance.

[List level 1] - If a seat is used to place items on (CBBG), these items may not weigh more than 46 kg per seat.

Note:

[List level 1] - When an extra seat is purchased to transport baggage in cabin, CCBG, the standard baggage allowance applies for every extra seat purchased.

[List level 1] - When an extra seat is purchased for comfort, EXST, the standard baggage allowance applies for every extra seat purchased.

Exception:
When an extra seat is purchased for corpulent passenger, the extra seat does not benefit of a free baggage allowance.

Accompanied Company Material (COML)

[List level 1] - All movement of accompanied company materials to/from outstations shall be approved and consented by controlling manager.

[List level 1] - All requests for authorizing excess COML as accompanied baggage shall be forwarded to the controlling Manager.

[List level 1] - The station teams shall ask for copies of consent.

[List level 1] - The approval shall be appended on the booking of the staff accompanying the company materials.

Special Baggage

Link to Special Baggage Website: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/plan/baggage-information/special-baggage/

General

[List level 1] - Special baggage is all baggage that, because of its nature, size, or weight, may be accepted only under certain conditions.

[List level 1] - For acceptance of special baggage the conditions of carriage applies.

[List level 1] - For some types of special baggage advance reservations should be made or Kenya Airways may refuse acceptance if deemed necessary.

[List level 1] - If accepted, baggage shall be packed by the passenger in such a way that the item and/or its contents are sufficiently protected to endure ordinary handling.

free checked baggage allowance applies for every extra seat booked (EXST). For example, 1 passenger books 2 extra M-Class seats for comfort. The total checked baggage allowance for this passenger will be 3 x applicable free baggage allowance.

[List level 1] - If a seat is used to place items on (CBBG), these items may not weigh more than 46 kg per seat.

[List level 1] - (The kilos placed on a seat, shall not be deducted from the total free checked baggage allowance.) Items placed on a seat should be adequately packed to prevent damage.

[List level 1] - Trunks and crates are not allowed as CBBG.

[List level 1] - Items must be stored on a seat and be properly secured by a safety belt or restraint device having enough strength to eliminate the possibility of shifting under all normal anticipated flight and ground conditions.

[List level 1] - The item shall be adequately packaged or covered in a manner to avoid possible injury to passengers and cabin crew members.

[List level 1] - Extra seats for stowage of items shall not be issued on the emergency exit row.

[List level 1] - The items carried on the extra seat shall not restrict access to or use of any required emergency or regular exit, or aisle(s) in the cabin.

[List level 1] - The items stowed shall not obscure any passenger’s view of the seat belt sign, no smoking sign or required exit sign.

[List level 1] - Items may not cause disturbance to other passengers.

[List level 1] - Both passenger and CBBG shall be booked in the same class of travel

The items shall be limited to the sizes stipulated below;

All cabin baggage shall have an "approved KQ cabin luggage" label attached as conformance to cabin baggage standards.

NOTE

[List level 1] - On top of the free cabin allowance, passengers are allowed to carry 01 bag of Duty Free in the cabin as accessories column above.

[List level 1] - Infants < 2 years NOT occupying a seat shall be allowed 1 piece of cabin baggage MAX 12kgs and MAX dimensions L55 x W25 x H35.

[List level 1] - For infants and small children who are seated on a passenger seat and need to be secured with an approved device for their comfort on board i.e car seat; the car seat used on board may be accepted on top of the normal free cabin baggage allowance. At the time of reservations, the accompanying person shall be informed that he/she is responsible for the installation of the car seat on board in compliance with the safety and installation instructions of the manufacturer.

[List level 1] - Some Airport Authorities or airlines may impose further restrictions for cabin baggage amount, size and/or weight. In such cases allowable piece shall be checked in free of charge, provided the size and weight are within the cabin baggage allowance weight. If not, normal excess baggage charges apply.

[List level 1] - As a mandatory standard each piece of checked in baggage shall have a name label that bears the passenger's name, physical address, and phone number on the outside and also on the inside. The name should be the same as the one mentioned on the ticket. An email address is also recommended.

Exceptions

[List level 1] - Guests travelling from Jeddah are allowed to carry one free bottle of Holy Water, Max 5 Litres. The bottle must be sealed with a plastic covering to avoid leakage. KQ has no liability on Holy Water, no claims shall be filed. Note: For ease of handling, the maximum weight of each piece of baggage shall not exceed 23kgs (50Ibs) and total dimensions shall not exceed 158cms (62 inches) (L+W+H)

[List level 1] - Under special conditions or authorization, non-normal item, motorized wheelchairs, special sporting equipment may be accepted as checked baggage with exceeding weight of 23kgs.

[List level 1] - In addition to free cabin baggage allowance, an infant is entitled to 1 collapsible stroller plus 1 car seat free of charge.

[List level 1] - Incapacitated passengers may carry one wheelchair or mobility device free of charge.

[List level 1] - The actual free allowance of the guest may differ if code share or interline traffic is involved. In these cases, the allowance is automatically calculated in compliance with IATA Resolution 302.

[List level 1] - Free baggage allowance applied will be as stated in the Departure Control System (DCS) or on the e-ticket.

where you will have the option to rebook yourself on your preferred flight. DO NOT CLICK ON DECLINE CHANGES as this will automatically direct you to the Customer Excellence Centre to rebook you.

Will I be charged for rebooking and how can I be refunded?

Self rebooking tool is purposely for disrupted flights. You will therefore not be charged for using it.

If my outbound flight has been changed, can I also change the inbound flight free of charge?

No. With the self-rebooking tool, you will only re-book yourself on the alternative flights of the disrupted sectors. If you wish to change the inbound because you lost a day(s) on the outbound, you will have to reach out to your travel agent or our Contact center office.

If checked-in, will the bags be transferred automatically to the new flight?

Yes, they will be transferred automatically.

Does the tool rebook other airlines document with KQ sectors like DL or AF?

Yes, it does. However, instead of revalidation, the ticket will be reissued.

Does the tool rebook award tickets?

Yes, it does

What happens if a flight is disrupted more than once?

You can self-rebook once per every disruption.

To be able to make an offer you need a valid and issued KQ Economy Class ticket for a scheduled flight operated by KQ. You may submit your Smart Upgrade offer up to 14 hours before Departure.

[List level 1] - At the end of the booking process there will be an automatic notification suggesting an upgrade

I change my Offer to a higher or lower amount?

Yes, you can change the amount before you receive a confirmation email informing you whether your Offer has been successful or not. All you need to do to change your Offer is to use the link from the upgrade offer email.

Apart from the Upgrade amount displayed, will there be additional taxes or charges?

No.

What happens if an Offer has been submitted, but the flight has to be changed or cancelled?

You may change or cancel your offer up to 13 hours before departure.

What happens if your Upgrade has been accepted, but you have to cancel your trip?

After your offer has been accepted, the Upgrade amount is no longer refundable.

What happens if your upgrade has been accepted, but KQ cancels your flight?

Your Upgrade remains valid if you a re-booked to another KQ flight at the same amount. Otherwise, we will refund the amount.

What happens if an Offer was cancelled by mistake?

Up to 13 hours before departure you may cancel, correct your offer or re-offer.

Is the time of making the Offer decisive for its ranking?

No.

You are travelling as a couple or family?

Upgrade to business class considers all passengers within a joint booking.

You are travelling with a colleague who does not want to Upgrade to Business Class?

As long as you are not registered under one and the same booking number, you may submit your individual offer.

What are the benefits of the KQ Upgrade to Business Class?

You receive an upgrade at an exceptional price and benefit from all amenities of the KQ Business Class, such as:

[List level 1] - Award-winning Business Class Service and delicious catering

[List level 1] - Access to our worldwide Business Lounges** including meals and drinks

FAQS

FAQs link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/help/faqs/

Booking & Payment FAQs

What are my payment options?

Pay quickly and efficiently through any of our payment options: credit and debit cards, eWallet , mobile payment or real-time bank transfer. Read more about our payments options.(Link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/book-manage/booking-online/payment-methods/ )

Can I make an online payment in a currency of my choice?

Our prices are automatically displayed based on the country you are booking from.

For example, if you are in the United Kingdom, booking a flight from Nairobi to London, the price displayed, and the price you need to pay, will be in British Pound.

Please note that if you’re paying with a different currency from your card, your financial institution may apply different exchange rates to the fare displayed on the booking page. There may be additional charges incurred, so please check with your financial institution before making your booking.

Can I make changes to my flight details?

Manage My Booking allows you to modify an existing flight booking:

[List level 1] - Change travel dates

[List level 1] - Upgrade to business class

[List level 1] - Request special meals

[List level 1] - Select preferred seats

[List level 1] - Purchase extra legroom

[List level 1] - Update contact information

[List level 1] - Pay in advance for excess baggage

[List level 1] - Request for refund

Can I modify my flight details online if I booked it through a travel agent or another website?

Bookings purchased directly from Kenya-airways.com, Kenya Airways direct offices and preferred travel agents can be modified online through Manage My Booking.

3.3.2 Should you wish to change any aspect of your transportation you must contact us in advance. The fare for your new transportation will be calculated and you will be given the option of accepting the new price or maintaining your original transportation as ticketed. 3.3.3 Should you change your transportation without our agreement, we will assess the correct price for your actual travel. We will refund you the difference if the new price is lower, but otherwise your unused Coupons have no value.

3.3.4 Please be aware that while some types of changes will not result in a change of fare, others, such as changing the place of departure (for example, if you do not fly the first segment) or reversing the direction you travel, can result in an increase in price. Many special fares are valid only on the dates and for the flights shown on the Ticket and may not be changed at all, or may be changed only upon payment of an additional fee.

9. You may revise or cancel your Offer as long as your Offer has not already been accepted by the Airline.

10. You shall not be entitled to withdraw the Offer after acceptance by the Airline, except and to the extent described in these Terms and Conditions.

12. There will be no refunds, credits, exchanges, or transfer of bids to another flight once your Offer has been paid for and accepted by the Airline except under the following conditions:

a) The flight on which you were upgraded was cancelled or disrupted due to a schedule change initiated by the airline.

b) The flight on which you were upgraded was cancelled and the airline re-accommodated you on another flight but in economy class.

c) Your Offer was accepted and you were given an Upgrade, but you were not able to be seated in business class for reasons attributable to the Airline, including, but not limited to, a change in equipment, a delay in the connecting flight that resulted in your missing the connection on which you were upgraded, but excluding reasons attributable to your actions.

where you will have the option to rebook yourself on your preferred flight. DO NOT CLICK ON DECLINE CHANGES as this will automatically direct you to the Customer Excellence Centre to rebook you.

Will I be charged for rebooking and how can I be refunded?

Self rebooking tool is purposely for disrupted flights. You will therefore not be charged for using it.

If my outbound flight has been changed, can I also change the inbound flight free of charge?

No. With the self-rebooking tool, you will only re-book yourself on the alternative flights of the disrupted sectors. If you wish to change the inbound because you lost a day(s) on the outbound, you will have to reach out to your travel agent or our Contact center office.

If checked-in, will the bags be transferred automatically to the new flight?

Yes, they will be transferred automatically.

Does the tool rebook other airlines document with KQ sectors like DL or AF?

Yes, it does. However, instead of revalidation, the ticket will be reissued.

Does the tool rebook award tickets?

Yes, it does

What happens if a flight is disrupted more than once?

You can self-rebook once per every disruption.

I change my Offer to a higher or lower amount?

Yes, you can change the amount before you receive a confirmation email informing you whether your Offer has been successful or not. All you need to do to change your Offer is to use the link from the upgrade offer email.

Apart from the Upgrade amount displayed, will there be additional taxes or charges?

No.

What happens if an Offer has been submitted, but the flight has to be changed or cancelled?

You may change or cancel your offer up to 13 hours before departure.

What happens if your Upgrade has been accepted, but you have to cancel your trip?

After your offer has been accepted, the Upgrade amount is no longer refundable.

What happens if your upgrade has been accepted, but KQ cancels your flight?

Your Upgrade remains valid if you a re-booked to another KQ flight at the same amount. Otherwise, we will refund the amount.

What happens if an Offer was cancelled by mistake?

Up to 13 hours before departure you may cancel, correct your offer or re-offer.

Is the time of making the Offer decisive for its ranking?

No.

You are travelling as a couple or family?

Upgrade to business class considers all passengers within a joint booking.

You are travelling with a colleague who does not want to Upgrade to Business Class?

As long as you are not registered under one and the same booking number, you may submit your individual offer.

What are the benefits of the KQ Upgrade to Business Class?

You receive an upgrade at an exceptional price and benefit from all amenities of the KQ Business Class, such as:

At Kenya Airways, we prioritize your well-being and comfort. By following these guidelines and policies, we aim to provide you with a seamless and enjoyable journey as you travel with us during your pregnancy.

If you have any inquiries or require further information, please don't hesitate to reach out to our customer service team. Your safety and satisfaction are our utmost priorities.

Special Meals

Catering to Your Dietary Needs with Kenya Airways

At Kenya Airways, we understand that our passengers have unique dietary, religious, and medical preferences. We are delighted to accommodate your special meal requests to ensure a satisfying journey. Here's how you can request your special meal:

Religious Meals:

[List level 1] - Hindu meals (HNML): This meal is for passengers wishing to follow Hindu customs and may contain one or more of the following ingredients: lamb, domestic fowl, fish, milk products, spicy foods, and curry.

[List level 1] - Kosher meals (KSML): This meal is for passengers who follow Jewish customs and are prepared with strict compliance of the Jewish dietary requirements. These meals should be ordered 48 hours before your scheduled departure and may not be available on all Kenya Airways flights.

level 1] - Seafood Meal (SFML): This meal is prepared according to passenger preference; fish and/or seafood prepared according to local specifications.

[List level 1] - Special Meal (SPML): This meal is prepared according to passenger preference; it is a special meal request that the airline wishes to accommodate for which there is no specific meal code.

[List level 1] - Timing: Make sure to request your special meal at least 24 hours before your flight's departure

[List level 1] - Booking Channels: You have various options to place your request:

[List level 1] - Online using the Book and Manage feature on the Kenya Airways website

[List level 1] - Contact our 24-hour call centre at +254 711 024 747

[List level 1] - At any Kenya Airways sales office

[List level 1] - Through your travel agency

Limited mobility? We’ve got you covered. Kenya Airways provides stretcher services subject to the medical clearance and conditions of carriage. Stretcher case clearance requires at least 48hrs prior notification.

Patients requiring medical support on board, such as those travelling on a stretcher or requiring prescribed oxygen (fees apply) please notify Kenya Airways doctors at least 48 hrs prior to your flight to ensure the seamless journey you deserve.

KQ Medical provides medical escort services at an extra fee.

8. Lease of Medical Escort Equipment

This option is available. Liaise with KQ Medical.

The name should be the same as the one mentioned on the ticket. An email address is also recommended.

Exceptions

[List level 1] - Guests travelling from Jeddah are allowed to carry one free bottle of Holy Water, Max 5 Litres. The bottle must be sealed with a plastic covering to avoid leakage. [List level 1] - In addition to free cabin baggage allowance, an infant is entitled to 1 collapsible stroller plus 1 car seat free of charge.

[List level 1] - Incapacitated passengers may carry one wheelchair or mobility device free of charge.

[List level 1] - The actual free allowance of the guest may differ if code share or interline traffic is involved. In these cases, the allowance is automatically calculated in compliance with IATA Resolution 302.

where you will have the option to rebook yourself on your preferred flight. DO NOT CLICK ON DECLINE CHANGES as this will automatically direct you to the Customer Excellence Centre to rebook you.

Will I be charged for rebooking and how can I be refunded?

Self rebooking tool is purposely for disrupted flights. You will therefore not be charged for using it.

If my outbound flight has been changed, can I also change the inbound flight free of charge?

No. With the self-rebooking tool, you will only re-book yourself on the alternative flights of the disrupted sectors. If you wish to change the inbound because you lost a day(s) on the outbound, you will have to reach out to your travel agent or our Contact center office.

If checked-in, will the bags be transferred automatically to the new flight?

Yes, they will be transferred automatically.

Does the tool rebook other airlines document with KQ sectors like DL or AF?

Yes, it does. However, instead of revalidation, the ticket will be reissued.

Does the tool rebook award tickets?

Yes, it does

What happens if a flight is disrupted more than once?

You can self-rebook once per every disruption.

special assistance

[List level 1] - Need in-flight oxygen, a portable oxygen concentrator (POC) or ventilator

[List level 1] - Need battery-powered* medical equipment (except for CPAP) or a medical procedure during the flight

If you have any of the above or other medical conditions, download and complete the MEDIF (Medical Information Form for Fitness to Fly) at least 24 hours before travel is due to commence and submit to doctors.kq@kenya-airways.com or our 24-hour Contact Centre Tel: +254 734 104 747, Mobile: +254 711 024 747 or WhatsApp: +254 705 474 747 for assistance.

2. Passenger Medical Clearance Services Process

Once cleared, we shall provide you with a Passenger Medical Clearance form (PMC) stating the conditions of clearance. You will be required to carry this form throughout your travel.

Kindly note:

[List level 1] - The MEDIF and any other medical report MUST be filled in English. It is valid for 7 days from the date of issue.

[List level 1] - The MEDIF MUST be completed fully including the passenger declaration part. It MUST be signed, stamped and dated clearly. Failure to fill it will lead to a delay in the clearance process.

[List level 1] - You will need a new MEDIF form for clearance on your return trip

[List level 1] - Notify Doctors.KQ@kenya-airways.com immediately of any change in your condition before your flight; If your condition changes significantly, you may be asked to obtain another MEDIF form to confirm that you are fit to fly

1. Who Requires Medical Clearance to Fly?

If you have a pre-existing medical condition, we advise you visit your doctor before you fly, so that we can know how to best serve you.

You require a medical clearance to fly if you:

[List level 1] - Recently had a major medical incident (heart attack, heart failure, stroke and respiratory failure, recent pneumothorax, etc).

[List level 1] - Had surgery within the previous two weeks

[List level 1] - One has a pre-existing heart or respiratory condition

[List level 1] - Have a medical condition which may be adversely affected by flying

[List level 1] - Have thrombophlebitis or history of pulmonary embolism

[List level 1] - Have unstable mental illness/impairment

[List level 1] - You are unable to care for yourself hence needs special assistance

[List level 1] - If you cannot use a normal upright seat e.g. a stretcher or medical condition that necessitates extra legroom

[List level 1] - Need in-flight oxygen, a portable oxygen concentrator (POC) or ventilator

[List level 1] - Need battery-powered* medical equipment (except for CPAP) or a medical procedure during the flight

Delayed, Lost or Damaged Baggage

Website page Link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/plan/baggage-information/delayed-baggage/

If your baggage is damaged on arrival, or does not turn up:

[List level 1] - Present yourself at the desk for file creation.

[List level 1] - Details of your baggage will be taken and you will be offered immediate assistance.

[List level 1] - You will be given a file reference number, which you should keep safe.

[List level 1] - You can track lost baggage online if you have a file reference number or call +254-20-3274747.

Track your baggage here: https://wtrweb.worldtracer.aero/WTRInternet/wtwflowinternet.do?_flowExecutionKey=_c7B9F6ACE-EF6D-A1BF-83D0-0B91E5F664EA_k7CE17609-FF4B-6805-F3F4-C66253CC389C

If your baggage is damaged on arrival, or does not turn up:

[List level 1] - Kenya Airways' liability could be reduced if baggage was presented for check-in unsuitably packed or after the recommended check-in time.

[List level 1] - If your baggage has been delayed, arrangements will be made to have it delivered to your local address when it arrives. This service is not available in some countries due to local government restrictions.

[List level 1] - Should you need to make a claim for compensation, this will be required in writing within seven days after your arrival to your nearest Kenya Airways airport office or you should contact your insurance company.

[List level 1] - To help us process your claim quickly, please quote the reference given to you when you reported your baggage as delayed or damaged.

Insurance and baggage liability limitations:

[List level 1] - Whilst we will make every attempt to ensure your baggage is handled with care, you should know that Kenya Airways' liability for loss, delay or damage to baggage is limited unless a higher value is declared in advance and additional charges paid.

[List level 1] - The extent of airline liability is not based on the weight of the luggage nor its value. Kenya Airways does not accept liability for fragile, valuable, perishable articles or baggage which is packed in damaged or unsuitable containers.

[List level 1] - Under the Conditions of Carriage(Link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/policies/conditions-of-carriage/ ) we accept no liability for the loss of jewellery, other valuables and money contained in checked baggage. You are advised to keep valuables, important documents and money either on your person or in your cabin baggage. We strongly recommend all passengers obtain adequate travel insurance cover prior to their journey.

First Needs Allowance (FNA) Payment:

Payment may be made to passengers who arrive at destinations other than their domicile country of residence without their checked baggage. It shall be noted that not all such passengers may need payment.

NOTE: Persons who are residents do not qualify for first needs payment, unless they show proof of residence in another country other than their domicile country for the last 6 months.

The following provisions shall therefore apply for delayed bags not received within 24hrs at the arrival airport where the missing report was filed: after 24 hours:

[List level 1] - First Needs Allowance (FNA) may be paid on the spot where it is ascertained that based on flight schedules, frequencies and connectivity, the missing bags shall not arrive within 24hours.

[List level 1] - Passengers receiving at least one of their bags may not be entitled to First Needs Allowance.

[List level 1] - Proof of Purchase of first needs items in form of receipts is required;

[List level 1] - Only essential items can be reimbursed;

[List level 1] - Applicable limits are:

[List level 1] - USD150 for First class and Premier World

[List level 1] - USD100 for Economy class passengers

[List level 1] - Children between 2-12 yrs. are entitled to 50% of the applicable limits in Economy and Business Class

[List level 1] - Children below 2 years are not entitled to First Needs Allowance Payment.

to rebook my flight?

Simply visit the Kenya Airways website(Link: https://www.kenya-airways.com/en-ke/ ), select “Manage Booking”

You will find the rebooking link at the top marked “Click here.

Where do I find the flight options available for rebooking?

Once you log in, you will be redirected to a page that has all available flight options and timings.

*Flight timings available for rebooking are either less than 24 hours from your original flight or 7 days after.

Can I rebook a flight that hasn’t been disrupted?

No. Only flights with a schedule change i.e. delayed or canceled are open for self-rebooking.

What happens if I do not rebook myself/are not able to rebook?

The system will automatically rebook you on the next available flight, after which you will receive an email with your new flight details.

Will I receive my e-ticket and boarding pass?

Yes, after you have selected and confirmed your new flight, you will receive an email confirmation as well as your e-ticket.

I have received an email that my flight has been canceled/rescheduled. Does that mean I have been rebooked?

The system will automatically rebook you on the next available flight. If you are happy with the new flight details highlighted on the email, click on “ACCEPT CHANGES”

However, if you would like to see more flight options, go to the Kenya Airways website and click on Manage my booking where you will have the option to rebook yourself on your preferred flight. DO NOT CLICK ON DECLINE CHANGES as this will automatically direct you to the Customer Excellence Centre to rebook you.

Will I be charged for rebooking and how can I be refunded?

Self rebooking tool is purposely for disrupted flights. You will therefore not be charged for using it.

If the baggage exceeds 32kgs or 300cms a “bulky XBAG transportation” message specifying the type and the dimensions is sent to the station.

[List level 1] - There is no weight limitation for wheelchair and mobility device however a comment has to be given on the PNR to enable plan for the right aircraft and ground handling process.

Fragile Baggage:

[List level 1] - Kenya Airways accepts no liability for fragile baggage, baggage with fragile contents, perishable items e-g food, meat, flowers etc. and Valuable. This information should be given to the passenger before accepting of such items.

[List level 1] - For fragile baggage the item shall be packed properly (original sealed box or suitable case) in order to endure normal handling. Mark “fragile” on the limited release part of the bag and a fragile sticker is affix on to the bag.

[List level 1] - Where perishable items require controlled temperature or specialized handling, passengers should be advised to transport as cargo.

[List level 1] - The passenger is responsible for ensuring the conformity of the health documents required for the trip and for hermetically packing in order to prevent any leaks, drips or odor.

to rebook my flight?

You will find the rebooking link at the top marked “Click here.

Where do I find the flight options available for rebooking?

*Flight timings available for rebooking are either less than 24 hours from your original flight or 7 days after.

Can I rebook a flight that hasn’t been disrupted?

No. Only flights with a schedule change i.e. delayed or canceled are open for self-rebooking.

What happens if I do not rebook myself/are not able to rebook?

The system will automatically rebook you on the next available flight, after which you will receive an email with your new flight details.

Will I receive my e-ticket and boarding pass?

Yes, after you have selected and confirmed your new flight, you will receive an email confirmation as well as your e-ticket.

I have received an email that my flight has been canceled/rescheduled. Does that mean I have been rebooked?

The system will automatically rebook you on the next available flight. If you are happy with the new flight details highlighted on the email, click on “ACCEPT CHANGES”

However, if you would like to see more flight options, go to the Kenya Airways website and click on Manage my booking where you will have the option to rebook yourself on your preferred flight. DO NOT CLICK ON DECLINE CHANGES as this will automatically direct you to the Customer Excellence Centre to rebook you.

Will I be charged for rebooking and how can I be refunded?

Self rebooking tool is purposely for disrupted flights. You will therefore not be charged for using it.

Does the Kenya Airways Upgrade to Business Class apply to the round trip? Can I choose any amount I want for my Upgrade offer?

The system has a default minimum and maximum bid amount set. It will not accept any offer lower than the minimum amount or higher than the maximum amount. All flight legs of your booking which are suitable for an Upgrade will be displayed. You decide for yourself which flights you'd like to make an offer on.

What does the Strength Indicator mean on the offer page?

The Strength Indicator is a guide that shows the strength of your bid but does not guarantee its success.

Can I offer different amounts for the Upgrade for each segment of my journey?

Yes, you can offer different amounts for each eligible segment.

How much does it cost to make an offer?

The offer is free of charge. Only if you receive the Upgrade, your credit card will be debited with the amount of your offer. Please, we still need your credit card details at the time of making your offer for standard verification purposes.

Can I change my Offer to a higher or lower amount?

Yes, you can change the amount before you receive a confirmation email informing you whether your Offer has been successful or not. All you need to do to change your Offer is to use the link from the upgrade offer email.

Apart from the Upgrade amount displayed, will there be additional taxes or charges?

No.

a proof of payment?

After booking your flight on Kenya-airways.com you will receive your ticket via e-mail as soon as we have received the payment.

Can I pay for a ticket for another person travelling from abroad?

Yes, you can book for another person travelling from abroad. However, if you choose to pay with credit or debit cards you may be required to present the card used for booking, it must be presented while checking into your flight at the commencement of travel. If you, as the credit card holder, are not travelling, a copy of the credit card with an authorization signed by yourself should be presented at check-in. alternatively, the card or a copy of the card with your signed authorization can be presented to the nearest Kenya airways ticketing office at least 72 hours before the flight. This verification is required to ensure a smooth check-in process at the airport and to avoid being refused carriage. Failure to comply will result in the requirement to pay the full ticket cost at the airport or refusal of carriage.

Is it possible for one to modify Multicity bookings online?

No, It is not possible for any changes to be made on multi-city bookings.

Can one make changes online to bookings that have been affected by schedule change?

No, one has to call our Contact center for Assistance.

When one is a no show can they make any changes to their booking online?

No this is not possible, one has to call our contact center for Assistance.

What happens to bookings that have been cancelled?

One cannot access any bookings that have been cancelled online.

I change my Offer to a higher or lower amount?

Yes, you can change the amount before you receive a confirmation email informing you whether your Offer has been successful or not. All you need to do to change your Offer is to use the link from the upgrade offer email.

Apart from the Upgrade amount displayed, will there be additional taxes or charges?

No.

What happens if an Offer has been submitted, but the flight has to be changed or cancelled?

You may change or cancel your offer up to 13 hours before departure.

What happens if your Upgrade has been accepted, but you have to cancel your trip?

After your offer has been accepted, the Upgrade amount is no longer refundable.

What happens if your upgrade has been accepted, but KQ cancels your flight?

Your Upgrade remains valid if you a re-booked to another KQ flight at the same amount. Otherwise, we will refund the amount.

What happens if an Offer was cancelled by mistake?

Up to 13 hours before departure you may cancel, correct your offer or re-offer.

Is the time of making the Offer decisive for its ranking?

No.

You are travelling as a couple or family?

Upgrade to business class considers all passengers within a joint booking.

You are travelling with a colleague who does not want to Upgrade to Business Class?

As long as you are not registered under one and the same booking number, you may submit your individual offer.

What are the benefits of the KQ Upgrade to Business Class?

You receive an upgrade at an exceptional price and benefit from all amenities of the KQ Business Class, such as:

[List level 1] - Award-winning Business Class Service and delicious catering

[List level 1] - Access to our worldwide Business Lounges** including meals and drinks

to rebook my flight?
